entities.summary: Southampton Solent University is a public university based in Southampton, United Kingdom. It has approximately 10,500 students (2019/20). Its main campus is located on East Park Terrace near the city centre and the maritime hub of Southampton. Southampton Solent University is a university in Europe, established in 2005-07-12.
